dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single, high-contrast white horizontal band across the greater coverts against a dark gray/blue wing base.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, linear white boundaries visible along the edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, irregular pale-yellow patch on the posterior neck/nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, distinct color boundary between the black crown and the pale nape patch, followed by a clear transition to the olive-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large white auricular (cheek) patch bordered by black; bright yellow ventral plumage with a prominent black central vertical stripe.
